name: soul
description: Put an oracle's soul to work inside another repo: list oracles, see the souls of a repo, preflight, bring a soul in, take it out, move a live body to #repo. A thin front for bin/herdr-soul and soul-in-repo.sh (laris-co/soul-in-repo); the herdr plugin laris.soul calls the same scripts.
author: neo-oracle

cli.help: maw soul <list|ls|check|in|out|migrate|help> [oracle] [repo] [--dry] [--yes] [--deny-main] — in, out and migrate print the plan; add --yes to run it (they write access rows: only on Nat's go from a terminal).
